certificate.family: wNEAR (near/core-contracts@54f8267 w-near, near-contract-standards 3.1.0), the code of wrap.near
certificate.statement: In the Lean model: in any state satisfying the invariant Inv, a registered holder u other than the contract itself that calls near_withdraw(b) with 1 yocto attached, b being its balance when the call executes, succeeds, and the contract sends u b+1 yocto. Only u's own calls, or the settlement of a transfer made to u (bounded by that transfer), lower u's balance. ft_resolve_transfer has effect only when the contract itself is the caller. total_supply equals the sum of balances.
assumptions: The theorem is about a model; the deployed bytes are tied to it by hash equality with the committed artifact and by execution on the nearcore runtime (tested, not proved).
Mainnet satisfies Inv: its solvency part was checked at block 224128229 (margin 3388 NEAR); supply = sum of balances over all records was not checked on mainnet.
The code was swapped once in 2021 by a key, without migration; the earlier code is tested, not proved; the account has had no keys since block 40858545.
The holder can attach 1 yocto (needs a full-access key or a contract) and enough gas; ft_transfer_call needs at least 30 Tgas (gas is not modelled).
certificate.binding: deployed code hash equals w-near/res/w_near.wasm committed at near/core-contracts@54f8267; wrap.near has no access keys
